# pb-agent

> pb-agent is an independent, open-source CLI and agent skill for safe AI coding agent access to PocketBase.

pb-agent lets agents inspect PocketBase health, collections, records, auth rules, files, logs, and backups. Mutations use immutable encrypted plans, environment-aware policy, scoped access grants, stale-state checks, secret redaction, and metadata-only audit evidence.

The project is pre-release, licensed under Apache-2.0, and currently targets PocketBase 0.39.8 with live capability probes.

## Important facts

- Production connections are read-only by default.
- Mutation plans expire after 15 minutes and are bound to one PocketBase instance.
- Updates and deletes abort if the target changed after planning.
- Credentials enter through stdin and are stored in the operating system credential manager.
- pb-agent intentionally provides no raw SQL or arbitrary HTTP escape hatch.
- MCP is deferred; the current agent-native surface is a JSON-first CLI plus an installable skill.
- pb-agent is free and open source. There are no paid plans.
